svg.title: The dynamic window, one step at a time
svg.desc: Four step sliding window loop: expand the right edge and add the entering element to the running state, check whether the window still satisfies the constraint, shrink from the left while it is invalid by removing elements from the state, and record the best answer. Because each pointer only moves forward, the total work is O of n rather than O of n squared.

svg.text: The dynamic window, one step at a time

text.font-family: Inter, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Expand right, shrink left, record. Each pointer only ever moves forward.

text.font-family: Inter, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: EXPAND — move right, add the entering element

text.font-family: Inter, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: One element enters the window. Update the running sum, the character count, or the

text.font-family: Inter, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: set of what is inside.

svg.text: CHECK — is the window still valid?

text.font-family: Inter, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Sum ≥ target? At most K distinct characters? The constraint from the problem

text.font-family: Inter, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: statement, evaluated in O(1).

text.font-family: Inter, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
Inter, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: SHRINK — move left while invalid, removing state

text.font-family: Inter, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Decrement the leaving element. Delete it from the map at zero, or your

text.font-family: Inter, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: distinct-count is silently wrong.

text.font-family: Noteworthy, 'Bradley Hand', 'Segoe Print', 'Comic Sans MS', cursive

svg.text: while, not if

text.font-family: Inter, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
Inter, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: RECORD — but where depends on the question

text.font-family: Inter, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Minimising a window: record INSIDE the shrink loop. Maximising: record AFTER

text.font-family: Inter, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: validity is restored — and a single if often replaces the while.

svg.text: Why it is O(n), said out loud

text.font-family: Inter, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Both pointers only move forward and neither can move more than n times, so the total

text.font-family: Inter, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: is at most 2n moves — despite the nested loop.
